passages.P_readA:
Once, a very old man went to a doctor to ask some questions about his wife's hearing. He was worried that she was going deaf, as she seemed to be having a hard time hearing the old man speak. The doctor suggested a test to find out exactly how bad her hearing was.
"Stand far behind her and ask her a question. If she doesn't answer, move a little bit closer and ask again. Keep doing this until you can know about how far away she can hear. If she can't hear you until you are quite close, she might have a hearing problem," the doctor said.
The old man then returned home. He was so __▲__ to finally work on a way to this problem that he almost shouted and jumped for joy all the way home. When he arrived home, he saw that his wife was cooking dinner. While standing about 15 meters behind her, he asked, "What's for dinner, dear?" But he got no reply.
He moved closer, standing about 10 meters away from her. He asked her the same question, but she still did not respond him. He then moved to 5 meters away and asked her the question again—but once again, she did not reply.
Fearing what would happen next, he moved until he was just 1 meter away from her. He asked her one more time, "What's for dinner, dear?"
His wife yelled back at him, "Why did you ask me so many times? We're having lasagna (意式千层面) for dinner!"

passages.P_readC:
"I regularly make new friends. My living and working spaces are clean and organized. I usually stay calm, even under a lot of pressure.... Am I an 'I' person or an 'E' person?" It is a popular topic among young people around China these days. Many young people are crazy about it so that they take a personality test named Myers-Briggs test to find out the answer.
Many people find the MBTI (Myers-Briggs Test Indicator) useful. It groups people into 16 types, which start with the letter "I" or "E", such as "ENTJ", "INFP" or more. "E" is short for "Extroversion" while "I" is for "Introversion". "I'm an 'E' person. I should go to the party and make more friends." "I'm an 'I' person. I'd like to work by myself. I could be a writer in the future." They believe different types can help them make decisions for activities, jobs or even future plans more quickly.
But there are also problems. Some people take the test for a second time and get different results. Some people find it hard to answer some questions. "I like watching TV by myself. But I also enjoy playing with friends. Am I an 'I' or an 'E'?"
When you take a personality test, you may think, "Oh, that's me." That's because the descriptions are common. They can be used to describe many people. Research has found that over 50% of people got a different score when they retook the MBTI just five weeks later. "Personalities can change with time, and they are not black-or-white," scientists say. You may be introverted now but become extroverted when you get older. Or, you can be both an "I" and an "E". You may find it hard to make choices sometimes. Studies have also shown that the test is not real at telling people's success in different jobs. So, don't take it too seriously.
passages.P_readD:
In recent years, many schools in China have had a high-tech makeover (爆改). They have turned from using "old-school" multimedia (多媒体) tools to AI and big data to add value to student learning and life on campus (校园).
At the Tianjin Eco-City School connected with Beijing Normal University, the Chinese tech company iFlytek's smart campus system makes learning a fun experience. In aerospace (航天) classes, students use VR glasses to learn about what's inside a rocket and how it is launched (发射) in a computer game. Also, in swimming classes, "by wearing smart ear-phones, children can get real-time instructions from the coach under the water. This makes swimming safer," Li Rui, the school's vice-principal told CCTV.
For PE classes, Yuwen School in Wuhu, Anhui, has used self-testing tools with AI visual analysis (视觉分析) technology for activities such as standing long jump, sit-ups and shot put (推铅球). With facial recognition technology, students can get voice report and results on how they did right after each exercise.
"Before, when I threw the shot put, the teacher had to use a ruler to measure how far it went. Now, the results just show up on their own. You can also see which parts of your exercise need improvement". Wu Shengguo from the school told Dajiang Evening News.
Apart from learning, students can also enjoy meals made by smart canteens (食堂). In June, Yingkou No. 1 Middle School in Liaoning introduced a smart canteen with an "online meal selection (选择) and facial recognition meal pickup" system. To meet the different needs of students, the canteen offers over 400 dishes, with six to seven choices for each meal. Parents and students can choose meals in advance (提前) from the online platform (平台). And they use facial recognition technology to pick up their meal. It helps the school plan and prepare meals, cutting down on food and kitchen waste.
passages.P_readE:
In the famous film Forrest Gump, there's a famous saying, "Life is like a box of chocolates, and you never know what you will get." The surprise is part of the fun. Now blind boxes are bringing the magic of surprise to online shopping. Merchants (商家) fill the boxes with random (随机的) toys which usually come from movies, comics and cartoons.
The earliest blind boxes have caught on since they were first introduced from Japan to China in 2014. It was a New Year's tradition. At that time, they called it "a lucky bag". According to a 2019 Tmall (天猫) report, the mini-series of the Labubu blind box was sold 55,000 in just 9 seconds during the Singles Day shopping event. Most customers for blind boxes are young people aged 18 to 35.
According to The Paper, blind box toys are popular in part because of their cute appearances at first sight. The cute mini-sized cartoon toys are suitable to place almost anywhere. What's more, even if blind box toys are not their top choice for decorations, the mystery and uncertainty of the process also attract people. 这就是人们一个接一个买盲盒的主要原因。
Opening a blind box is a pleasant little surprise for our daily lives. When people open this simple little box, they may be disappointed (失望的), but the uncertainty is part of the fun. People will open more blind boxes and hope for a better outcome. In fact, although the magical blind boxes are full of fun, we should come to a rational (理智的) decision.

Capybaras mostly live in South America. They look like a very large mouse. A mouse-like animal may not be __82__ (welcome) by many, but capybaras always have lots of different animals around them.
What __83__ (make) capybaras so friendly? As the __84__ (big) rodent animal (啮齿动物) in the world, capybaras have only a few enemies (天敌), such as leopards (豹子) and eagles. Living by water, it is easy for them to hide in the water to stay away from __85__ (dangerous). They live such a comfortable life that __86__ seems to make them worry.
Capybaras eat plants for a __87__ (live). They won't hurt other animals. Capybaras usually eat water plants in the morning and evening, spending the rest of the day __88__ (bath) in water and resting on the shore (岸边). Sometimes, they take small animals like birds, turtles, ducks, and even monkeys for a free ride. __89__ they are also called "animal buses".
Capybaras are also getting popular __90__ friends of humans. More and more people around the world want to raise a capybara as a pet. After all, no one can say no to such a cute and kind friend.

questions.stem:
— Look! There is ______ Italian restaurant on the right.
— Oh, I didn't know it. It must be a new one.
questions.analysis: 句意泛指一家意大利餐馆，且 Italian 以元音音素 /ɪ/ 开头，前面要用不定冠词 an，故选 B。

questions.stem: When the leaves are ready, they are picked ______ hand and are sent ______ processing.
questions.tag: 介词固定搭配（by hand / send for）
questions.analysis: by hand 表示“手工、用手”；be sent for processing 表示“被送去加工”，for 表目的，故选 A。

questions.stem:
— There are just 24 hours in each day, so it's important for us to spend our time ______.
— You're quite right. What we do with time makes all the difference.
questions.analysis: 每天只有24小时，明智地（wisely）安排时间很重要；quickly 意为“快速地”，simply 意为“简单地”，故选 C。

questions.stem:
— I wonder ______ we will have a field trip to Zhuba next week.
— Well, it depends on the weather.
questions.analysis: 由答句“这取决于天气”可知上句想表达“不知道下周是否去竹坝研学”，wonder 后接表示“是否”的宾语从句用 whether，故选 B。

questions.stem:
— This job ______ you to travel often for business. Can you accept it?
— Sure. That's OK with me!
questions.analysis: require sb. to do sth. 表示“要求/需要某人做某事”；suggest 没有 suggest sb. to do 用法，encourage 意为“鼓励”，不符合工作要求出差的语境，故选 C。

questions.stem:
— How did you know Billy didn't listen carefully?
— Just look at the ______ expression on his face!
questions.analysis: absent 除了“缺席的”，还可作“心不在焉的、茫然的”讲，absent expression 指走神茫然的表情，符合“没认真听讲”的语境，故选 A。

questions.stem: ______ a good habit is hard, but it's even harder to break a bad one.
questions.analysis: 空格处作全句主语，动词原形不能作主语，To developing 结构错误，需用动名词 Developing 作主语，故选 B。

questions.stem: William Shakespeare has been dead for more than 400 years, but his works still have a great ______ today.
questions.analysis: have a great influence 表示“有很大的影响”；background 意为“背景”，direction 意为“方向”，故选 A。

questions.stem: The doctor examined Peter carefully after he ______ to the hospital.
questions.tag: 一般过去时的被动语态
questions.analysis: 主句 examined 为一般过去时，且主语 he（Peter）是被送到医院的，应用一般过去时的被动语态 was taken，故选 C。

questions.stem:
— ______ film You Only Live Once is! I was deeply moved.
— So was I. It is the best film I've ever watched this year.
questions.analysis: 感叹句的中心词是可数名词单数 film，要用“What + a/an + 形容词 + 单数可数名词 + 主谓”结构，即 What a great film，故选 C。

questions.stem:
— It's pouring outside! How did you come here without getting wet?
— Mr. Green ______ and gave me a ride.
questions.analysis: pass by 意为“路过、经过”，符合“经过顺便载我一程”的句意；pass away 意为“去世”，pass on 意为“传递”，故选 C。

questions.stem:
— Who do you think is right, Jim or Leo?
— I can't decide until I have heard ______ sides of the story.
questions.analysis: 空格后 sides 为复数名词，且语境指听完 Jim 和 Leo 双方的话才能判断。both 后接复数名词表示“两者都”，either 和 each 后接单数名词，故选 B。

questions.stem:
— Do you know ______?
— She is Wang Haoze. She is China's first female civilian astronaut.
questions.analysis: 宾语从句需用陈述语序（连接词 + 主语 + 谓语），排除 A、B；答句回答的是身份姓名“她是王浩泽”，询问“是谁”用 who，故选 C。

questions.stem: The famous poem "As the bright moon shines over the sea, from far away you share this moment with me." tells us ______.
options: A. how beautiful is the moon at the Mid-Autumn Festival
B. what did the writer want to share with his family far away
C. how much the writer missed his relatives at Mid-Autumn Festival
questions.answer_display: C. how much the writer missed his relatives at Mid-Autumn Festival
questions.analysis: 宾语从句要用陈述语序。A 项 is the moon 和 B 项 did the writer want 均是疑问语序，只有 C 项语序正确且贴合诗句思亲之意，故选 C。

questions.stem:
— I've kept a diary for a month, but there is little progress in my writing.
— Well, ______. Keep writing and you'll be better at it some day in the future.
questions.analysis: 由后句“坚持写下去将来就会进步”可知，这里是在安慰对方进步需要时间，it takes time 意为“这得慢慢来 / 需要时间”，故选 A。

questions.stem: When her friends were enjoying the ______ milk tea and desserts, Zheng spent 360 days a year keeping to a strict diet.
questions.analysis: the latest 表示“最新的、最流行的”（最新的奶茶和甜品），与定冠词 the 搭配符合语境，故选 C。

questions.stem: She is always the first one to get to the training place and the last ______.
questions.analysis: the first / last (one) to do sth. 是固定用法，用不定式作后置定语，与前面的 the first one to get to... 呼应，故选 A。

questions.stem: This month, Zheng ______ the whole world with her excellent performance.
questions.analysis: surprise sb. with sth. 意为“以……惊艳/使……惊喜”，她在奥运网球单打夺金让全世界惊叹；succeed 为不及物动词，不直接接宾语，故选 B。

questions.stem: It seems that all her hard work finally paid ______ in Paris.
questions.analysis: pay off 意为“得到回报、取得成功”，她十多年的刻苦训练终于在巴黎获得了回报，故选 C。

questions.stem: ______ unforgettable experience winning the gold medal was!
questions.analysis: experience 作“经历”讲为可数名词单数，且 unforgettable 以元音音素开头，要用“What an + 形容词 + 单数可数名词 + 主谓”结构，故选 B。

questions.stem: "______ the match was almost over, my hands were shaking, but I paid much attention and tried my best to hit the next ball," Zheng told the reporters.
questions.analysis: 空格后是完整句子 the match was almost over，不能用介词 During；根据“尽力打好下一球”可知比赛尚未结束，是“当比赛快结束时”，故选 C。

questions.stem: "When I won, I felt like I ______ the pressure properly and did better than I ever thought I could."
questions.analysis: deal with the pressure 意为“应对/处理压力”；start with 以……开始，come up with 想出，故选 B。

questions.stem: People used to call her "Fire" ______ she was very crazy about what she liked.
questions.analysis: 后半句“她对喜欢的事非常狂热”是人们称她为“Fire”的原因，前果后因用 because 引导原因状语从句，故选 A。

questions.stem: But now, Zheng has learned to control ______ and be patient too.
questions.analysis: control oneself 意为“控制自己”，主语为 Zheng，对应的反身代词是 herself，故选 C。

questions.stem: This new way of playing has made her even more successful, and her fans now ______ her "Queen Wen."
questions.tag: used to / be used to doing
questions.analysis: be used to doing sth. 表示“习惯于做某事”，粉丝现在习惯称她为“Queen Wen”；used to do 表“过去常常”，与 now 矛盾，故选 C。

questions.stem: Why did the old man go to the doctor?
options: A. He couldn't hear what his wife said.
B. He felt anxious about his poor hearing.
C. He wanted to have a medical examination.
D. He was worried about his wife's hearing.
questions.answer_display: D. He was worried about his wife's hearing.
questions.analysis: 由第一段“He was worried that she was going deaf...”可知老人是担心妻子的听力才去看医生，故选 D。

questions.stem: How many times did the old man asked his wife about what's for dinner?
questions.analysis: 老人分别在距离妻子15米、10米、5米和1米时各问了一次“What's for dinner, dear?”，一共问了4次，故选 C。

questions.stem: Which of the following statements might be suitable in __▲__?
questions.analysis: 由后半句“he almost shouted and jumped for joy all the way home”可知老人高兴得一路欢呼跳跃，说明他非常兴奋（excited），故选 B。

questions.stem: What does the word "yell" mean?
questions.analysis: 妻子先前其实回答了只是老人听不见，走到1米处又问一遍，妻子不耐烦地大声喊着回话，yell 意为“大喊”，故选 C。

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT true according to the passage?
options: A. The old man thought his wife seemed to be having a problem in hearing.
B. The doctor gave some advice to the old man to test his hearing.
C. It is the old man himself who had much difficulty in hearing.
D. The old man stood 15 meters away from his wife when he asked the first question.
questions.answer_display: B. The doctor gave some advice to the old man to test his hearing.
questions.analysis: 医生建议的是用来测试老人妻子的听力（test her hearing），而不是测试老人自己的听力（his hearing），故事结尾揭示真正耳背的是老人自己，所以 B 项表述有误，故选 B。

questions.stem: If you want to go to Grand Castle of King Charles from Westside Church, you will go past ______ stations between them.
questions.analysis: 沿 Line A 箭头方向从 Westside Church 前往 Grand Castle of King Charles，中间依次经过 Starlight Garden、Great Age Theatre、City Square、King James' Castle、Lovers' Bridge 共5个站点，故选 A。

questions.stem: Besides Central Station, buses for both lines pass ______.
questions.analysis: 对比地图上实线（Line A）和虚线（Line B）的站点，除起点 Central Station 外，两条路线共同经过的站点是 Lovers' Bridge，故选 B。

questions.stem: You can take the City Sight Bus after 20:00 ______.
questions.analysis: 海报写明旺季（4月到9月）每天开放至 22:00，淡季（10月到3月）只开放至 19:00；6月属于旺季，20:00 之后仍可乘坐，故选 B。

questions.stem: Amy and her friend Penny want to buy tickets online to King Henry's Garden with two pet dogs. They have to pay ______ for the City Sight Bus.
questions.analysis: King Henry's Garden 在 Line B 上（每人 $18），两人共 $36；两只宠物半价各 $9，共 $18；合计 $54，网上购票享九折（省10%），即 $54 × 0.9 = $48.6，故选 C。

questions.stem: You may read the poster ______.
questions.analysis: 这则海报介绍了城市观光巴士路线、开放时间与票价，最可能出现在城市旅游指南（city guidebook）中，故选 D。

questions.stem: What is MBTI?
options: A. A test about stress problems.
B. A test with the same answer.
C. A test about young people in China.
D. A test for your personality type.
questions.answer_display: D. A test for your personality type.
questions.analysis: 第一段明确说明它是一项名为 Myers-Briggs 的性格测试（a personality test），第二段指出它将人分为16种性格类型，故选 D。

questions.stem: According to the test, an "I" person is usually ______ than an "E" person.
questions.analysis: 文中提到“E”代表外向（Extroversion），喜欢聚会交友；“I”代表内向（Introversion），喜欢独自工作，因此“I”型人通常更安静（quieter），故选 A。

questions.stem: What do you probably like to do if you are an "E" person?
options: A. To read books in the library in the free time.
B. To cook simple meals at home on weekends.
C. To watch movies with a pet dog on Friday night.
D. To celebrate different festivals with different people.
questions.answer_display: D. To celebrate different festivals with different people.
questions.analysis: 外向（E）型人倾向于社交和结交朋友，“和不同的人一起庆祝不同节日”符合外向者的喜好，而 A、B、C 均偏向独处，故选 D。

questions.stem:
What are the problems of the test?
① The test is too black-or-white.
② It costs much money to take the test.
③ Some questions are difficult to answer.
④ You need to take it many times to get the result.
questions.analysis: 第三段指出有人觉得部分问题很难回答（③），第四段指出性格并非非黑即白（①）；文中未提及测试费用高，也未说必须测很多次才能出结果，故选 B。

questions.stem: What's the writer's main purpose in writing the last paragraph?
options: A. To introduce what MBTI is.
B. To explain how people use MBTI.
C. To tell whether MBTI is useful.
D. To list how many people use MBTI.
questions.answer_display: C. To tell whether MBTI is useful.
questions.analysis: 最后一段分析了 MBTI 描述泛化、重测结果易变、无法真正预测工作成功，并得出“不要太当真”的结论，旨在说明 MBTI 是否真的可靠有用，故选 C。

questions.stem: Which of these are used in the aerospace classes?
questions.analysis: 由第二段“In aerospace (航天) classes, students use VR glasses to learn about what's inside a rocket...”可知航天课上使用了 VR 眼镜，故选 B。

questions.stem: How do students feel about the swimming classes?
options: A. They can't hear the instructions clearly.
B. It's like studying in the classroom in real time.
C. The training process is much safer.
D. They find it hard to stay underwater for long.
questions.answer_display: C. The training process is much safer.
questions.analysis: 由第二段“by wearing smart ear-phones, children can get real-time instructions from the coach under the water. This makes swimming safer”可知游泳训练变得更安全，故选 C。

questions.stem: How can facial recognition technology help students with their PE classes?
options: A. It's used to measure the shot put's weight.
B. It can check whether the student is using a self-testing tool.
C. It provides more information for better meal choices.
D. Students can learn how to improve their exercise from it.
questions.answer_display: D. Students can learn how to improve their exercise from it.
questions.analysis: 由第三、四段可知，人脸识别结合 AI 视觉分析能即时播报成绩并指出运动中需要改进的地方，故选 D。

questions.stem:
How does the smart canteen system work? Please select the correct order of actions.
a. Students pick up their meal using facial recognition.
b. The canteen makes six to seven choices for each meal.
c. Students enjoy their meal.
d. Students order their meal online.
questions.analysis: 智慧食堂流程为：先提供每餐六七种选择（b）→ 学生家长在线提前订餐（d）→ 刷脸取餐（a）→ 享用美食（c），顺序为 bdac，故选 A。

questions.stem: What would be the best title for the passage?
options: A. The birth of global villages.
B. The improvement of technology in China.
C. New technology used in schools.
D. Student comfort in everyday school life.
questions.answer_display: C. New technology used in schools.
questions.analysis: 全文通过天津、芜湖、营口三所学校的智慧校园、AI体育测评与刷脸食堂，集中介绍新技术在中国学校中的应用，故选 C。

questions.stem: What are filled in the blind boxes according to the article?

Random toys.
Toys from movies, comics and cartoons.
questions.answer_display: Random toys (which usually come from movies, comics and cartoons).
questions.analysis: 第一段末句明确提到商家在盲盒里装入通常来自电影、漫画和动画的随机玩具（random toys）。

From Japan.
They were from Japan.
questions.analysis: 第二段首句提到最早的盲盒是从日本引入中国的（introduced from Japan to China），因此来自日本。

questions.stem: According to Paragraph 2, who bought most of the blind boxes?
reference_answer: Young people aged 18 to 35.
Young people.
questions.analysis: 第二段末句指出盲盒的主要购买群体是18到35岁的年轻人（young people aged 18 to 35）。

questions.stem: How should we treat buying blind boxes?

We should make a rational decision.
Rationally.

questions.analysis: 文章最后一句指出尽管盲盒充满乐趣，我们仍应作出理智的决定（come to a rational decision）。

people buy blind boxes one by one

questions.tag: 汉译英（定语从句与短语）

questions.stem:
以李华的身份代表小组作英语报告，介绍泉州蟳埔“簪花围”(Zanhuawei)，约100词（开头结尾不计入）。
开头：Dear classmates, I'm very glad to share our research with you. The subject ______
结尾：That's all for my presentation. Thank you.
questions.reference_answer:
写作要点提纲：
1. 点明主题：小组研究的是泉州蟳埔“簪花围”(Zanhuawei in Xunpu, Quanzhou)。
2. 历史地位：追溯至宋代，有千年历史；2008年入选国家级非物质文化遗产名录(National Intangible Cultural Heritage List)。
3. 材料与制作步骤：材料为鲜花、丝绸花等；选各色鲜花烘干，丝绸染色剪成花形，制成花冠(wreath)并系在发髻(bun)上。
4. 文化象征：体现蟳埔妇女勤劳、热心、勇敢的品质，象征美丽、幸福与希望。
5. 补充与个人感受：可补充当地民俗体验/传承意义，表达自豪感与传承中华传统文化的意愿。
questions.answer_display: 要点齐全（主题+历史+材料+4步制作+象征+感悟），时态准确（介绍事物用一般现在时，历史事件用一般过去时），约100词。
questions.tag: 书面表达（传统非遗文化介绍）
questions.analysis: 审题需完整覆盖表格7个维度并补充 Others 与 Your feelings；介绍制作步骤时可使用被动语态（如 are chosen, are dyed and cut）或祈使/连接词（First, Next, Then, Finally）使报告条理清晰。
